title: temu orbital strike cannon
description: This project adds orbital strike cannon that activates by dropping
body:
This project adds an orbital strike cannon that you can activate by throwing it, stackable, works on servers.

```
/function temuosc:give
```

Once you throw the item (drop), the cannon will activate

You can activate the nuke without item by doing this (you will die)

```
/function temuosc:spawn
```

You can give another player the cannon using this

```
/execute as PLAYERNAME run function temuosc:give
```
